crossRefs.note: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do?’ ”
He said, “What is the thing that he has spoken to you? Please don’t hide it from me. God do so to you, and more also…
then Zedekiah the king sent, and had him brought out. The king asked him secretly in his house, “Is there any word from…

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has Yahweh spoken?”
translations.bsb: So he returned to Balak, who was standing there by his burnt offering with the princes of Moab. “What did the LORD say?” Balak asked.
translations.kjv: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?
translations.asv: And he came to him, and, lo, he was standing by his burnt-offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath Jehovah spoken?
